# AZ Tech IT Repair — Ashburn, VA

AZ Tech IT Repair is a local computer repair shop serving Ashburn, Virginia
and nearby towns, including Sterling, Leesburg, Herndon, and Reston in
Loudoun County.

## Services

- Computer repair — desktops that will not boot, crash, overheat, or run slowly
- Laptop repair — screens, batteries, keyboards, charging ports, and hinge damage
- Virus and malware removal — pop-ups, browser hijacks, ransomware scares, spyware
- Data recovery — photos, documents, and work files from failing drives and dead devices
- Phone repair — screens, batteries, charging ports, and water-damaged phones
- Gaming console repair — PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch: HDMI, disc drives, overheating, controller drift

## How it works

Walk-ins are welcome. Diagnosis and quotes are free, and the exact price is
approved before any work starts. Many common repairs are completed the same
day or the next business day.
